http_target.description: Backend target for HTTP/1.x traffic; format: hostname[:port]. Defaults to localhost:80 if unset.

dns_target.description: Backend target for DNS traffic; format: hostname[:port]. Defaults to localhost:53 if unset.

idle_timeout.description: Idle session timeout in milliseconds. Set to 0 to disable timeout. Default is 600000 (10 minutes).

debug.description: When true, enables verbose debugging output to stderr.
